research_notes: Obtain dated DFAT/PMO/NSW appointments, identify consulting/legal employers and hours, map BIT title and employing-entity changes, AITSL cessation and campaign leave, NSW Telco tenure and 2023–2025 work; confirm System 2 primary governance/executive records.

2026-09-29 initial avenues: frozen APH occupations; AITSL 2018–19 and 2020–21 reports; historical budget/control statement; first-person Asian Australian Project interview; Nesta speaker record; UK spin-out announcement; NSW Telco and network reports; full-time and employer searches. Large NSW annual report could only be read through indexed leadership extract; no unsupported full-document claim.

AITSL March 2019 start is supported; full-time campaign language does not prove previous employment hours. BIT had mixed ownership after its 2014 spin-out; ownership shares alone are not a control finding. Preserve unknown sector until relevant appointment and control dates are established.

CIN board interval 2022–July 2023 is not automatically NSW Telco employment duration. Guest teaching, school representation and governance excluded. No senior title or aggregate payroll/FTE statistic is used to infer individual full-time status. Partial record remains unresolved.
